segments.content:
Chapter 161: 0158 Arrangements Must Also Be Made Back Home (Extra Chapter for Alliance Leader Kevin Daoren)

His cousin-uncle, Feng Tao, who sold and repaired computers, had a business that was now booming.

Compared to when Chen Guiliang brought Bian Guanyue over to get a computer repaired, his business volume had increased by at least 60%.

As the economy developed, more and more people were buying computers!

Exhausted after a long day, Feng Tao had just gotten home when he received a call from Chen Guiliang.

His wife was cooking in the kitchen, and his son was sprawled over the coffee table playing with toys. Feng Tao lay on the sofa, thoroughly content, and answered the phone, "Well, if it isn't the top student. What made you think of calling me?"

"Isn't it because I missed you, Cousin-Uncle?" Chen Guiliang said with a laugh. "How's business at the shop?"

Feng Tao said with a hint of pride, "Not bad. Doesn't Brother Gang have an 80% stake in the computer shop? He told me to earn money and slowly buy it back. I've already bought back 35%. Counting the 20% I originally had, I now own 55% of the shop. Hehe, the majority shareholder!"

"Congratulations, congratulations."

Chen Guiliang made some more small talk, "Cousin-Uncle, could you do me a favor tomorrow? Buy a mobile phone and deliver it to my dad at home."

"No problem. Your dad should have gotten a mobile phone long ago," Feng Tao said.

Chen Guiliang said, "You know I'm running a company. This time, I've secured a bit of investment, and I'm worried that if the news gets back, some people might get ideas. So, I need to discuss it with my dad."

"How much investment?" Feng Tao asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "You should be able to see the news on online channels like Sina Finance and Sohu Finance. It's hard to explain in just a few sentences. Cousin-Uncle, you'll understand once you read the news."

After ending the call, Feng Tao picked up his son and went to the study to turn on the computer.

A few minutes later, Lin Chunhong brought the dishes to the table, "Time to eat."

"Yeah, in a minute," came a very perfunctory reply from the study.

Lin Chunhong walked in, "Come and eat first. You can play on the computer later."

Feng Tao pointed to the news on the Sina Finance channel, "Come and see this."

Lin Chunhong carefully read the news article from start to finish. Staring at Chen Guiliang's photo on the screen, she felt her head spin. "He's a hundred-millionaire just like that?"

"I'm a little dazed myself," Feng Tao said.

Lin Chunhong knew Chen Guiliang was in business; she was even a loyal user of the Youke Hutian platform—busy stealing vegetables every day!

After calming down a bit, Lin Chunhong said, "Why don't we borrow some money from him and buy out the rest of the shares in the computer shop?"

Feng Tao thought about it seriously, "There's no need. It's not like Brother Gang is rushing me. He just got his investment, and we immediately ask to borrow money? What would that look like?"

"He's a hundred-millionaire, it's not like he's short on that little bit of money," Lin Chunhong said.

Feng Tao's expression turned unhappy, "It has nothing to do with how much money he has. Even if he's a hundred-millionaire, that money didn't just fall from the sky."

Lin Chunhong pointed at the computer, "The news said it was venture capital. Venture capital, isn't that like money falling from the sky?"

"It's called venture capital, not 'windfall' capital!" Feng Tao felt his wife was being a bit unreasonable.

Lin Chunhong was also a little displeased. She went to the living room to eat by herself, muttering, "If you don't want to borrow, then don't. Pride will be the death of you. When your nephew went to the essay competition, and when he went off to Peking University, I was the one who boiled eggs for him."

Chen Guiliang had struck it rich, yet this couple was now at odds.

The next day.

Feng Tao arrived at his shop and left his apprentice in charge while he went to a neighboring shop on the same floor to buy a mobile phone.

He then went to get a SIM card and top it up with credit, before riding his motorcycle to the countryside.

Chen Xinghua and Yao Lan were in the fields reaping wheat. They would be able to finish harvesting all of it today.

When Feng Tao arrived, only Grandma was at home, threshing the newly harvested wheat ears with a flail.

"Auntie, you're threshing the wheat," Feng Tao called out.

Grandma was very happy to see him and quickly went back into the house to boil some water.

Feng Tao asked, "Where are my cousin and his wife?"

Grandma said, "Reaping wheat. They'll be back soon."

Feng Tao sat down on a small stool. A black-and-white cat pounced over, scratched his pant leg a few times, and then quickly ran away. Seeing no reaction from Feng Tao, the cat cheekily came back to cause more trouble.

"Go on, git..."

Feng Tao shooed the cat away with his foot, took a sip of water, placed the cup back in the main hall, and then picked up a flail to help with the threshing.

Grandma ran to the kitchen to find a knife to kill a chicken.

"Auntie, I'm not staying for a meal. I have to get back to the shop for business!" Feng Tao quickly tried to stop her when he heard the chicken squawk.

Grandma said, "The work these past few days has been exhausting. Even if you hadn't come, I was going to kill a chicken anyway."

Feng Tao hesitated, then simply called his apprentice, "It's about time you graduated. You're in charge of the shop today. I probably won't be back until the afternoon."

After hanging up, he went back to threshing the wheat.

After about half an hour of work, Chen Xinghua came home carrying a load of newly reaped wheat on a shoulder pole—it was cut together with the stalks, which could be used as firewood.

"Cousin!"

Feng Tao put down the flail and handed the phone box to Chen Xinghua. "Your son bought this. He wants you to call him."

"Much appreciated. Stay for lunch before you go. I'll go buy a few bottles of beer," Chen Xinghua said, inviting him to stay.

Feng Tao stopped him, "Don't worry about that. Call Guiliang first. He has something to tell you."

Chen Xinghua remembered his son's number and immediately dialed it while standing in the courtyard. "Liangliang, what's up?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Dad, some newspapers will report that I've become a rich man. The news will probably reach the village in a few days. I've sent some money to your card. I want you to donate a computer and a printer to the town's police station. Have Cousin-Uncle help you buy them. He knows the market. You can just get the computer from his shop."

"I'm a big, strong man. Do I need protection from the police station?" Chen Xinghua said, amused.

Chen Guiliang said, "It's not just the police station. You also need to visit the officials in the town and the village. Tell the town and village officials that my business is just starting out, and I can't spend the investment money carelessly. The investment firm has people keeping an eye on it. Promise them that I'll donate money to pave the village road next year, and the year after, I'll make a donation to the town."

Chen Xinghua finally sensed something was off. "Exactly how much money do you have?"

"On paper, it's over a hundred million, but it's all just an estimate," Chen Guiliang said. "The money for the computer and printer donation to the police station this time is from my royalties. You must explain clearly to those officials that I don't have much cash right now, and the investment funds can't be used indiscriminately."

Chen Xinghua looked at Feng Tao, "He said over a hundred million?"

"Yeah," Feng Tao nodded.

Chen Xinghua didn't show much of a reaction, but his mind went blank, as if he had temporarily lost the ability to think.

Seeing that his father was silent for a long time, Chen Guiliang said, "Dad, give the phone to Cousin-Uncle."

Chen Xinghua subconsciously handed over the phone.

Chen Guiliang said, "Cousin-Uncle, go inside and get a pen and paper. I'll tell you what to write down."

"Okay."

"First, no matter who you see, tell them I don't have much money. The money from the investment firm can't be spent recklessly, and all that valuation stuff is just an illusion."

"Second, donate the computer and printer to the police station first. Say that I bought them with my royalties. The reason for donating to the police station is because of that incident in junior high. I want to thank the officers for bringing the bad guys to justice!"

"Third, get to know the town and village officials. Just say my company is new and doesn't have money yet. Once I make some money next year, the first thing will be to donate funds to pave the village road with cement. When I make even more money, I'll make a donation to the town the year after next."

"Fourth, for my Second Uncle and the neighbors, buy them some meat, and get their children some toys and snacks. Don't just do it once. Visit them often and give them small favors. If anything happens, the neighbors will be there to help out."

"Fifth, for my maternal grandparents, have them be a bit more generous too. Tell them to give small things to the neighbors often. Have my dad withdraw three thousand yuan from the card for them. Don't give too much, it might attract thieves."

"Sixth, if anyone asks to borrow money, use the same excuse. If it's really unavoidable, you can lend up to 2,000 yuan. Absolutely no more than that. Once you start, it'll never end."

"Seventh, for all the old creditors, pay them back all the interest. Just say that you were embarrassed before for only paying back the principal and not calculating enough interest. Also, visit them often. If anything comes up, these people will also help."
